svg.aria-label: Azure and GCP multi-cloud landing zone high-level design

g.text: Azure & GCP Multi-Cloud Landing Zone — High-Level Design (HLD)
Azure hub-and-spoke with FortiGate NVA · GCP Shared VPC with VPC Service Controls · hybrid IPsec + BGP · Terraform delivered by Azure DevOps Plan → Approval → Apply
Project-15 · reference design v1.0 · interview whiteboard
App Gateway WAF v2 is the
GCP Shared VPC per env, host
no stored secrets or SA keys
State: azurerm blob lease · GCS lock
Hybrid & cross-cloud transit · IPsec IKEv2 + BGP · on-prem FortiGate ↔ Azure VPN GW (A/A) ↔ GCP HA VPN
cert from Key Vault via UAMI
NSG: app tier → db ports only
Peering: hub allow gateway transit · spokes use remote gateways · allow forwarded traffic · non-transitive
data 10.10.16.0/20 · Private Google Access · flow logs · IAP 35.235.240.0/20
Access levels + ingress/egress rules · Cloud Build private pool
Shared VPC admin: compute.xpnAdmin at folder
Private Google Access · org log sink
every acronym used in this diagram
Ingress — internet users via App Gateway WAF
Delivery — Azure DevOps via OIDC / WIF
Shared VPC — service projects use host subnets

Ingress: Internet → App Gateway WAF → FortiGate → spoke · East-west: spoke → UDR → FortiGate ILB → spoke · Hybrid: on-prem FortiGate ⇄ Azure VPN GW / GCP HA VPN (BGP) · Deploy: PR → ADO plan → approval → apply
Reference design for interview discussion · IP ranges and ASNs are examples · no customer data
